title: CodonForge shared definitions
description: Primitive types and value objects reused across every CodonForge contract. Nothing in this file is a message on its own; it exists so that identifier syntax, provenance and uncertainty are defined exactly once.

SchemaVersion.description: SemVer of the document schema. Major changes are breaking; see 02-schemas/README.md for the evolution rules.

ContractMajor.description: Major version of the landscape query/response contract. Every model artifact declares which contract major it satisfies; the registry refuses to co-resolve artifacts with differing majors.

Sha256Digest.description: Content digest of the canonical serialization (RFC 8785 JCS for JSON documents, raw bytes for binary blobs).

Iso8601.description: UTC timestamp, RFC 3339, always with an explicit offset.

HostId.description: Stable host identifier: lowercase snake-case binomial, NCBI taxonomy id, optional strain suffix. The taxid is what the nearest-host fallback in ADR-0009 uses for phylogenetic distance.

TenantId.description: Opaque tenant identifier. Appears in every artifact manifest and every observation; the isolation invariant in ADR-0006 is stated over this field.

JobId.description: ULID-based, lexicographically sortable by submission time.

ArtifactId.description: Human-readable artifact coordinate. NEVER sufficient on its own for reproducibility - it must always travel with a Sha256Digest, because a channel may be re-pointed.

TermId.description: Namespaced objective/diagnostic term identifier. The namespace is the owning module; adding a term is additive and does not bump ContractMajor.

ObjectiveDirection.description: Declared once per term in the response so that the search engine never hard-codes a sign convention.

DnaSequence.description: Uppercase DNA. RNA input is transcoded U->T at ingest; the internal representation never carries U.

CodonString.description: A DNA string constrained to a whole number of codons. The regex is the frame-safety guarantee at the wire level.

ProteinSequence.description: One-letter amino acids; U=selenocysteine, O=pyrrolysine, X=unknown; optional single trailing stop.

Anticodon.description: tRNA anticodon, 5'->3'. I denotes inosine at the wobble position, which the wobble table treats explicitly.

CodonSpan.description: Half-open interval over CODON indices [start, end). All spans in CodonForge are codon-indexed; nucleotide indices appear only in ingest-facing schemas and are always named *_nt.

NtSpan.description: Half-open interval over NUCLEOTIDE indices [start_nt, end_nt) relative to the construct 5' end.

Unit.description: Free-form but drawn from a documented vocabulary. Every numeric term in a LandscapeResponse must declare one; a unitless objective vector is not reproducible across model versions.

Uncertainty.description: Predictive uncertainty for a scalar term. `method` and `calibrated` are mandatory because ADR-0005 makes uncertainty a ranking input, and an uncalibrated sigma silently corrupts probabilistic dominance.

sigma.description: Standard deviation of the predictive distribution, in the term's unit.

method.description: `none` is legal and means the term is deterministic (e.g. usage.cai); it must not be confused with an unknown uncertainty.

calibrated.description: True only if the interval passed the coverage gate TST-UNC-002 on a held-out set recorded in the artifact manifest.

Provenance.description: Which artifact produced a value. Recorded per term, not per response, because a single response mixes terms from many artifacts.

engine.description: Named compute engine when the term is not model-based, e.g. `native_window`, `viennarna`, `linearfold`.

resolved_by.description: Which rule of the ADR-0009 resolution ladder selected this artifact.

fallback.description: True when resolution fell below the host_channel rung; consumers must widen uncertainty and tag the candidate `low_confidence_host`.

BudgetTier.description: Named compute budget. The tier changes which terms are evaluated and with which engine; see ADR-0008 for the full degradation ladder.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem detail. The single error shape for every REST endpoint and every CLI non-zero exit.
